compiled_state.description:
## Context
Create can leave a real Jira issue without durable local identity. The coordinator must preserve write-ahead pending state and must never blind-replay an ambiguous create.

## Outcome
Coordinate the pre-create pending lifecycle intent and one budgeted Cloud/DC create call. A pending-save failure makes zero provider calls; ambiguous completion re-observes only through replay-safe identity/query seams or defers.

## Plan
1. Execute the versioned pending-binding intent durably before any create call. Return item-scoped persistence failure on save error.
2. Call create once through the shared logical budget. Do not wrap the compound legacy create path.
3. On timeout/connection loss, search only by replay-safe identity/query evidence. Return recovered success when the exact issue is proven; otherwise retain pending state and defer.
4. Record returned Jira key immediately in the typed outcome for downstream containment; never delete a successful remote issue.
5. Implement Cloud/DC failure cuts before save, during create, and immediately after key return.

## Testing
Stateful fakes assert local bytes, provider call counts, known-key outcome, ambiguity, and no remote delete.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Failed pending save produces zero Jira calls and an item-scoped persistence outcome.
- [ ] One physical create invocation issues exactly one provider create call.
- [ ] Timeout/connection loss never blind-replays.
- [ ] Exact replay-safe observation may recover success; inconclusive observation retains pending state and defers.
- [ ] A returned Jira key is preserved in every later failure outcome.
- [ ] No failure path deletes a successfully created Jira issue.

## Out of scope
Label/property containment, local confirmation, restart convergence, and family cutover.
